[N. A]
^ff0000Butcher^000000 is the newest development
by us, the Einbroch Firearm Lab.
It is the newest type of Gatling
we have developed. While
^ff0000Drifter^000000 is a good weapon
as well, the ^ff0000Butcher^000000 definitely has
a much stronger firepower!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是我们艾音布罗克枪械实验室最新研发的武器。
它是我们开发出的最新型加特林机枪。虽然^ff0000流浪者^000000也是一把好枪，但^ff0000屠夫^000000的火力要强得多！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Due to its strong firepower,
the Butcher was also dubbed
as the 'Murderer'.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
由于火力强劲，屠夫也被人称为“杀手”。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
However, even Gunslingers could
have troubles controlling such
a powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
不过，即使是神枪手，想要控制这么强大的武器也会感到吃力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you think you can handle it?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你觉得你能驾驭它吗？

scripts.text: I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我不确定

scripts.text: Of course I can!!
scripts.translation: 我当然可以！！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Butcher^000000 is a weapon that you
can't handle without a strong
will. I'll see you again when
you have enough confidence to
handle this monster.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是一把没有强大意志就无法驾驭的武器。
等你有足够的自信能驾驭这个怪物时，我们再见面吧。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Aha, how self-confident you
are! However, I see people with
such self-confidence everywhere.
You'll need to prove it...
But how... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈，你倒是很有自信！不过，自信的人我见得多了。
你得证明给我看...可怎么证明呢...嗯...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Hmmm......

[N. A]
Aha! I got it!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈！我想到了！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Here, bring me ^ff00001000 Orc Claws^000000 and ^ff00001000 Skel Bone^000000.
If you can bring me these items,
I'll let you use the Butcher.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
给我带来^ff00001000个兽人指甲^000000和^ff00001000根骷髅骨头^000000。
如果你能带来这些物品，我就让你使用屠夫。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Easy, ain't it? Go and prove
your ability then! Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
很简单吧？
那就去证明你的本事吧！嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you're here to learn about
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是来打听^ff0000流浪者^000000的吧？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Drifter^000000 is one of the many
highest-classed weapons developed
by Lady Celena. It's an automatic
Gatling which boasts very high
rate of fire, which is the highest
among all Gunslinger weapons.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000流浪者^000000是塞蕾娜女士开发的众多最高级武器之一。
它是一把自动加特林机枪，拥有极高的射速，是所有神枪手武器中射速最高的。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Of course, you will need the Skill
to allow you to control Gatlings,
but he who contorls Gatlings well
will receive full aid from the
^ff0000Drifter^000000.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
当然，你得学会操控加特林的技能。不过，只要能熟练操控加特林，就能充分发挥^ff0000流浪者^000000的威力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you want to try using the ^ff0000Drifter^000000?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你想试试使用^ff0000流浪者^000000吗？

scripts.text: Um, no.
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Yeah!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you want to try it out
some time, come back here.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你以后想试试，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Since it's really hard to find
the materials for constructing
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000, we only make them
on requests, and we require those
who want to use the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 to bring
us the materials.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
由于很难找到制造^ff0000流浪者^000000所需的材料，我们只接受订制；想使用^ff0000流浪者^000000的人必须自备材料。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I'll tell you the materials
needed, just bring them and
we'll construct it for you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我会告诉你需要的材料，只要把它们带过来，我们就为你制造。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
To make a Drifter, we need
70 Steel, 5 Eluniums, 3
Oridecons, 70 Coal, 50 Rusty
Screws, and a fee of
50,000 zeny.
Come back after you found
them all.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
制造一把流浪者需要钢铁70个、铝5个、神之金属3个、煤炭70个、生锈的螺丝50个，另需支付50,000 Zeny。
集齐材料后再回来。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I have news on the latest
weapons but... I guess you're
too busy to hear them.
Maybe next time I guess.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我这里有最新武器的消息，不过...看来你忙得没空听。
那就下次再说吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
You are overweight.
Even if I gave you the
weapon, you cannot carry it.
Please clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
你超重了。
就算我把武器给你，你也拿不动。
请清理一下你的物品栏。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hmm... Oh?
Ahh...... Eh?
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
Hmm... Oh?
Ahh... Eh?

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Heheh... Hmm... Huh...?
May I have my Butcher back now?
scripts.translation: 现在可以把屠夫还给我了吗？

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Uh? Oh, umm... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呃？哦，嗯... Heheh...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Th-that, huh? Eh... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
那...那个，是吗？呃... Heheh...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Ahahahah! I uh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈哈哈！我...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
That thing! BOOM!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
那东西！轰！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Bam bam! I was gonna fire it!
Yeah!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
砰砰！ 我本来想开火的！
没错！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But it resisted! So I went 'BAM!' with
my hand! MUAHAHAHAH!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
可它不听使唤！所以我就用手“BAM!”地敲了它一下！
哇哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
And it broke...... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
然后它就坏了... *呜呜*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I call myself 'Dr. Everything' and
I wanted to fix it myself, but I
don't seem to have the materials
to fix it... And the materials are
so rare too... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我自称“全能博士”，本想自己修好它，可我好像没有修理用的材料...那些材料也很稀有... *呜呜*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Umm... I'm sorry for breaking
it but... Could you get me the
materials I need for fixing it?
Bring me those items, and I can
fix it, plus I'll modify it for
you! I promise!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嗯...把它弄坏了，我很抱歉...你能帮我找些修理材料吗？
把材料带来，我就能修好它，还会替你改装！我保证！！

scripts.text:
So please bring me the materials...
*sob sob sob*
scripts.translation:
所以，请把材料带来...
*呜呜*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
I think only Lady Celena can
make those rods......
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要钢铁10个、铝2个、神之金属1个、煤炭20个...
还有屠夫专用的特殊金属棒...
我想只有塞蕾娜女士能做这种金属棒...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But first, you'll need to talk
to Lady Celena's assistant, the 'Lab Director',
and ask for his help.
That kid's a bit hysterical, but
she'll be nice help if you talk
to her nicely...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
不过，你得先去找塞蕾娜女士的助手“实验室总监”，请他帮忙。
那孩子有点歇斯底里，不过只要你好好跟他说话，他就会很乐意帮忙...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I'm really sorry... Here, I'll
lend you my prized weapon,
'Crimson Bolt'. But make sure
you bring all those materials
to me once you find them all!
Promise me!!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
真的很抱歉...来，我把我的宝贝武器“鲜红闪电”借给你。
找到所有材料后，务必带回来给我！答应我！！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Talk to the 'Lab Director' for his
assistance on the Rod.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要钢铁10个、铝2个、神之金属1个、煤炭20个...
还有屠夫专用的特殊金属棒...
去找“实验室总监”，请他帮忙找金属棒。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me! I'll get to the repair
right away, please hold on...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！
你为我找到了所有材料！
我马上开始修理，请稍等...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me!
... But where's my treasured
'Crimson Bolt'!? I will not fix
your Butcher for you if you don't
bring it back to me!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！你把材料都找齐了！
...可是我的宝贝“鲜红闪电”呢！？
你不把它带回来，我就不帮你修屠夫！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Good thing you found the
Special Metal Rod already.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是10个钢铁，2个铝，1个神之金属，20个煤炭...还有一根屠夫用的特殊金属棒...幸好你已经找到了那根特殊金属棒。

scripts.text:
-You're overweight already.-
-Come back after dropping some
stuff first.-
scripts.translation:
-你已经超重了。-
-先丢下些东西再回来。-

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Whew... Finally it's fixed, thanks
to your effort. I'm very sorry
for breaking it, and thank you
for your effort. I feel guilty
for just fixing it, so I added
some extra power on it. I hope
it'll work nicely for you.
Well, enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呼...终于修好了，多亏了你。弄坏它，我真的很抱歉，也谢谢你付出的努力。
只把它修好还不足以弥补我的愧疚，所以我还额外增强了它的威力。希望你用着顺手。
好了，好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
唉，真无聊...
不知道有没有什么有趣的事...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Oh well... I'll just play with my
beautiful 'Crimson Bolt'.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
算了...我还是玩玩我漂亮的“鲜红闪电”吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
唉，真无聊...
不知道有没有什么有趣的事...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Eh? Are you a Gunslinger?
I haven't seen that weapon
in your hand before...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
咦？你是神枪手吗？
我以前没见过你手里这把武器...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
May I take a look? Please?
C'mon, let me take a look!
I'm bored out of my mind here!
Pleeeeeeeeeeeease~?
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
能让我看看吗？拜托了？
快点嘛，让我看看！
我在这里都快无聊死了！
拜托嘛~？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text: Here...
scripts.translation: 给你

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hah! You think you're the only
one with a cool weapon!? Well
I got my beautiful Crimson Bolt!
Hmph!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
哈！你以为只有你有很酷的武器吗！？我也有我漂亮的鲜红闪电！哼！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Heheh... This is the newest
development by Einbroch Firearms
Lab, the so-called uncontrollable
'Destroyer Butcher', eh?
Interesting... VERY interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿嘿...这是艾音布罗克枪械实验室最新研发的武器，也就是那把传闻中难以驾驭的“屠夫”，对吧？
有意思...非常有意思...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hey, let me try it out for a
bit, alright? Don't worry, I
know how to handle weapons,
I won't break it!
That's that! Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿，让我试一会儿，好吗？别担心，我很会用武器，不会弄坏的！
就这么说定了，我们走吧~
